note: How an estate moves from one rulebook (metamodel) version to the next — `sdem migrate --estate DIR`. Every change to the rulebook that affects data bumps metamodel_version in every metamodel file and adds one entry here, from the old version to the new: its steps are applied to the estate's datasets and registry, then the estate is checked; an entry with no steps only moves the version (an additive change — new optional attributes or types). Step kinds: rename_type {from, to}; rename_attribute {type (optional), from, to}; drop_attribute {type (optional), name}; set_attribute {type, name, value} (only where missing); rename_kind {from, to} (a within-architecture link kind); rename_relationship {from, to} (a link type between architectures, in the registry). Policy: docs/sdem-rulebook-versioning.md.
